projects.description: smbcmp is a simple CLI tool that uses Wireshark CLI version (tshark) to dump and diff traces. It currently uses the plain text output format of tshark but tshark also has a proper XML output. The goal of this project would be to use or combine current tshark output with the XML output to do better and deeper diffs (ignoring indentation differences, adding ways to let users add ignore rules, etc).

projects.description: The project is about designing and implementing a Samba AD management tool for performing operations typically done via the samba-tool command line utility. The goal of the project is to give the end user a simpler and intuitive way of doing what the ‘samba-tool’ command line utility can accomplish with a few clicks. The project requires integrating Samba AD with Cockpit. The front-end will be implemented using HTML, CSS and JavaScript(React). Python scripts will be used to test and run the application.
